_comment: BUG-246 — the committed floor for the number of checks registered in scripts/verify.mjs. THE ONE HOME for this number: scripts/check-floor-smoke.mjs reads it, and so does the unconditional assertion in verify.mjs's own driver. Never lower it to make a run go green; that is the exact move this gate exists to stop. Raise it in the SAME commit that adds the new check(s).
why: On 2026-10-15 merge b6356bf discarded origin/main wholesale and deleted 9 of the 55 check registrations. npm run verify then printed 'ALL 46 CHECKS PASS', exit 0, with no objection: the suite had no idea how big it was supposed to be. 57 = the 55 restored by the BUG-245 merge, plus this floor gate itself, plus the BUG-230 finish-path set-integrity gate, plus the BUG-233 D6b mutation-record gate (floor raised 57 to 58 in the commit that registered it), plus the BUG-145 log-window DST gate (floor raised 58 to 59 in the commit that registered it), parsed by scripts/check-floor-smoke.mjs (which counts arrow AND bare-function registrations; a grep for the name field agrees). BUG-249 days-ago label DST gate (floor raised 59 to 60 in the commit that registered it). BUG-250 pointer-freshness gate (floor raised 60 to 61 in the commit that registered it). BUG-255 profile display-name gate (floor raised 61 to 62 in the commit that registered it). BUG-246 merge-parity gate, the commit-graph PRIMARY mechanism (floor raised to 63 in the commit that registered it). NOTE ON THIS NUMBER, because it was a rebase conflict and not a simple increment: origin had raised the floor to 62 (BUG-255) while the merge-parity commit raised it to 61, so NEITHER side's value was correct for the merged suite — 62 would have left one registration deletable in silence and 61 two. It was RECOMPUTED from the merged scripts/verify.mjs (63 registrations parsed) rather than resolved by picking a side, which is the same rule program-snapshot.json conflicts follow. BUG-256 d4 display/identity-split gate, scripts/display-name-smoke.mjs (floor raised 64 to 65 in the commit that registered it). BUG-257 accessory-derivation order-independence gate, scripts/accessory-derivation-order-smoke.mjs (floor raised 65 to 66 in the commit that registered it).
